module purpose: This module is a synchronous read-only memory interface: on clk_i it loads rdata from the constant array mem_rom_c using bus_req_i.addr, latches a read-enable decision rden from bus_req_i.stb and not bus_req_i.rw, and returns the registered data and acknowledge on bus_rsp_o while driving bus_rsp_o.err low.

use-case flows.value: read-response enable decision captured from bus_req_i.stb and not bus_req_i.rw
address-selected ROM word loaded from mem_rom_c into rdata on a rising edge of clk_i
captured ROM word returned on the response data path when rden = '1'

conceptual assets.reasoning: The start/report/reset flows depend on the registered decision in rden: reset forces rden <= '0' (lines 57-58), and otherwise rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) (line 60). The map records rden as GATED_BY bus_req_i.stb and bus_req_i.rw at line 60, and that stored decision both gates bus_rsp_o.data (line 64) and is copied to bus_rsp_o.ack (line 65). Corrupting this decision would acknowledge or suppress a response contrary to the implemented read predicate; availability is also established because the decision is refreshed on each rising edge of clk_i and forced low during reset. The consumed request fields are on transport port bus_req_i, so the internal register rden is the eligible structural reference.

conceptual assets.concept: Address-selected ROM word returned by the memory interface
conceptual assets.reasoning: The operate/read-out flow loads rdata <= mem_rom_c(to_integer(unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(boot_rom_size_index_c+1 downto 2)))) on each rising edge (line 48) and bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0') (line 64). The map records rdata as SELECTED_BY bus_req_i.addr at line 48 and SOURCES bus_rsp_o.data at line 64. Integrity requires the delivered word to match the constant ROM entry selected by the sampled address slice; availability is established because rdata is captured every clock and delivered on cycles where rden = '1'. The flow graph leaves rdata unreached because mem_rom_c is a constant outside the map, but RTL line 48 is authoritative; the address field and response record are transport elements and are not structural references here.
